name: JCW's (American Fork & Lehi, UT) Charbroiled Plain Cheeseburger on White Bun
brandOrRestaurant: JCW's The Burger Boys (American Fork & Lehi, UT)
whyItWorks: Famous Utah Valley burger spot! High flame charbroiling allows excess fat to drip off the beef patty. On a plain bun with ketchup, it is very easy on digestion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Charbroiled Cheeseburger plain with ketchup only (hold lettuce, tomato, onion, and pickles).
